name: Banco MCP
description: Aggregates bank data (balances, bills and statements) via Brazil's Open Finance. Each institution becomes a connection; multiple banks per user are stored in credentials.connections[]. Read-only.

name: Conta Azul
description: Brazilian financial ERP Conta Azul (API v2). Manage customers/suppliers, products, services, sales, contracts, receivables/payables, installments, NF-e invoices and settlements via OAuth 2.0. Platform provides the OAuth app, just click Authorize and log into your Conta Azul account.

name: Instagram
description: Publish photos, videos, carousels, Reels and Stories, manage comments and direct messages, and read profile and media insights through the official API. With the Advanced plan you also like posts, follow and unfollow, and list and view other profiles' stories. Connect in 2 clicks (Business or Creator account) or with username and password, which supports 2FA.

name: Gmail
description: Gmail in natural language: read, search, send and organize emails, drafts and labels. The platform provides the OAuth app, just click Connect and pick your Google account. Multiple Gmail accounts can be connected to the same MCP.

name: WhatsApp
description: Connect a personal/Business WhatsApp account via QR pairing (multi-device, like WhatsApp Web). Send and read messages, list chats, contacts, groups, and run full-text search across history. Optional SOCKS5/HTTPS proxy per connection, recommended to avoid datacenter-IP blocks (Cloudflare/AWS).

name: Jurisprudência
description: Brazilian case law search built for AI agents, across 17 courts: the Supreme Court (STF), the Superior Courts (STJ, TST), federal appellate courts, the federal tax council (CARF) and eleven state courts. Every decision comes with the judging body, rapporteur, date, the exact snippet that matched your query and the link to the official site, with full text when available. Searches reach what each court has published, and the response tells you when a source is unavailable or its records are outdated instead of returning an unexplained blank. Free, no login, no credentials.

name: Astrea (Aurum)
description: Reporting, queries and organization over Astrea (Aurum), Brazilian legal-practice software: cases per client, calendar (hearings, meetings, deadlines, tasks), new cases per month, tags, finance (fees/expenses) and case timelines. Also bulk apply/remove tags and post a manual case entry, to clean up and organize the portfolio. Auth via Astrea username + password (a dedicated integration user is recommended). Internal API; no official public API.

name: Legal MCP
description: Legal discovery for your AI, find lawsuits by name, CPF, CNPJ or case number and build a consolidated X-ray (cases, publications, sanctions, municipal mentions and case law). Works instantly, no login. An alternative to services like Jusbrasil for lawyers and law firms.

name: DataJud (CNJ)
description: Public lookup of Brazilian court cases (metadata + docket movements) via the CNJ/DataJud public API: superior courts (STJ, TST, TSE, STM), state, federal, labor, electoral and military justice. Finds which instance a case is in now (origin court + superior court, e.g. TRT → TST). No credentials; hosted by the platform.

name: DJEN (Diário de Justiça)
description: Brazil's National Electronic Court Gazette (CNJ/DJEN), judicial publications and notifications. Search by bar number (OAB), lawyer name, case number, court and date; each result includes the full text and certificate link. No credentials; hosted by the platform. (It is the court gazette, not a case-law database.)

name: Console
description: Marketplace and admin in one surface: search, install and run MCPs in natural language, and manage your mcp.ai workspace (toolkits, MCPs, logs, usage). No credentials, uses your own workspace context.

name: NotebookLM
description: Google NotebookLM via natural language: create notebooks, add sources (PDF, URL, YouTube) and ask grounded, citation-backed questions. NotebookLM has no official API, connect in one click with the mcp.ai extension (captures your Google session cookies; stored encrypted on the platform).

name: CNPJ
description: Public CNPJ lookup (legal name, trade name, status, activity, partners) via BrasilAPI, free, no credentials. Also discovers the company's (and partners') lawsuits by name via the official gazette (DJEN).

name: Jus MCP
description: The whole Brazilian legal stack in a single connection, no login. Lawsuits, court publications, case law, judicial calculations, public tenders and audit rulings, clearance certificates, sanctions and compliance, plus 150+ queries against official sources. Works instantly, pay per query.

name: Instagram Scraper
description: Access to public Instagram profiles: posts, reels, stories, highlights, hashtags and search. Hosted by the platform, no credentials required.

name: Google Calendar
description: Google Calendar in natural language: list, create, update and delete events, check availability and invite attendees. The platform provides the OAuth app, just click Connect and pick your Google account. Multiple accounts can be connected to the same MCP.

name: Olist Tiny ERP
description: Olist Tiny e-commerce ERP (formerly Tiny ERP) with the full official REST API v3, products, stock, orders, fiscal invoices (NF-e/NFC-e), accounts payable and receivable, contacts, shipping, purchase and service orders, CRM and price lists. Read and write. Pairs with the Banco MCP to reconcile bank and ERP. You create the app in your Olist account and authorize via OAuth.

name: LinkedIn
description: LinkedIn in natural language, within the scope LinkedIn auto-approves for self-serve apps: read your own profile, publish posts on your wall and delete your own posts. The platform provides the OAuth app, just click Connect and pick your LinkedIn account. Multiple accounts can be connected to the same MCP. Reading other people's profiles, search, Sales Navigator and Recruiter require LinkedIn partner approval and are not available here.

name: Google Drive
description: Google Drive in natural language: search, read, create, move and share files and folders. The platform provides the OAuth app, just click Connect and pick your Google account. Multiple accounts can be connected to the same MCP.

name: Discord
description: Connect a Discord bot (bot token from the developer portal) to read/send messages, list guilds and channels, react, send DMs and manage messages via the official REST API (discord.com/api/v10). Optional Guild ID sets the default server used by tools like list_channels and list_guild_members.

name: Capivara: Investigação Cadastral
description: 360º background dossier on a person (or company) from name + CPF: identity, contact, money-to-claim (Central Bank unclaimed funds, income-tax, benefits), credit, criminal records/sanctions, corporate ties, vehicles and lawsuits, in a single report. Flat price per query (prepaid), in 3 tiers. Platform-hosted, no credentials.

name: Asaas
description: Digital account and billing on Asaas with the full official REST API v3 (api.asaas.com), balance, charges (boleto/PIX/card), subscriptions, installments, payment links, split, anticipations, transfers, PIX, statement, invoices and subaccounts. Read and write. Pairs with the Banco MCP, the Banco shows money received, Asaas operates what you charge. Auth via an API key (generated in the Asaas account, under Settings, Integrations, API Key). If you restrict the key by IP, allowlist the fixed outbound IP 3.94.44.196.

name: Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)
description: Read and manage Meta Ads campaigns, ad sets, ads, audiences, pages and Business Manager. You provide a long-lived access_token and the Facebook App ID (FB_API_ID).

name: Consultas
description: Official-source lookups on people and companies: registration status (CPF/CNPJ), Simples/MEI, SINTEGRA, clearance certificates (Federal CND, CNDT, FGTS), TCU, sanctions (OFAC/UN/ICIJ) and NF-e. Platform-hosted, no credentials, pay per query with prepaid credit.

name: Omie
description: Financial & accounting management on Omie (Brazil's leading cloud ERP), payables/receivables, financial movements, reconciliation, bank accounts, customers/suppliers and NF-e invoices, via the official JSON API (app.omie.com.br). Reads and also creates and edits payables and receivables, and attaches receipts and documents to entries. Pairs with the Banco MCP for bank-vs-ledger reconciliation. Auth via app_key + app_secret (generated in the Omie account, Settings → General → API).

name: YouTube
description: Search, video, channel, playlist, comments, trending and related items from YouTube. Reading is hosted by the platform, no credentials required. Connect your channel with Google to reply, comment and moderate comments through the official API.

name: Google Sheets
description: Google Sheets in natural language: read, write, search and format cells, create spreadsheets and tabs, apply formulas. The platform provides the OAuth app, just click Connect and pick your Google account. Multiple accounts can be connected to the same MCP.

name: Social → Context
description: Paste a social-media link (TikTok, Instagram reel/post/carousel, YouTube, or any .mp4) and get its content as text: metadata, an audio/video transcript, and a vision description (OCR + summary) of the images. Gives Claude context about what's inside a video or post. All logic runs on a dedicated Cloudflare Worker (download + transcription + vision). Free: 3 calls.

name: Outlook
description: Outlook in natural language: read, search, send and organize emails, folders and contacts, and view or create calendar events. Works with personal accounts (outlook.com, hotmail, live) and with company Microsoft 365. The platform provides the OAuth app, just click Connect and pick your Microsoft account. Multiple accounts can be connected to the same MCP.

name: Calculadora Jurídica
description: Automatic Brazilian legal calculators: monetary correction and debt settlement (correction by IPCA, INPC, IGP-M, SELIC, TR and other official indices + interest, penalty and attorney fees), with indices fetched live from BACEN and IBGE. No credentials; platform-hosted. Built for judgment liquidation, enforcement, collection actions and rent/alimony updates.

name: Nota Fiscal
description: Issue and manage Brazilian service invoices (NFS-e) by chatting with your agent, platform-hosted, no nfe.io account needed. Connect your CNPJ + A1 certificate and issue, query, download (PDF/XML) and cancel NFS-e.

name: Google Ads
description: Full Google Ads management: read (campaigns, performance, ROAS, keywords, search terms) and write (pause/enable/remove campaigns, ad groups, ads and keywords, adjust budget and bid, create budget, campaign, ad group, positive/negative keywords and RSAs). You provide developer token, OAuth client_id/secret, refresh_token and MCC, no server-side OAuth.

name: CPF
description: Validates CPF (check digits) and discovers lawsuits by CPF, searching by NAME in the official gazette (DJEN). Note: CPF→name is not public data; provide the holder's name (recommended). No credentials.

name: Garmin Connect (treinos)
description: List, fetch, create, edit (replace), delete and schedule structured workouts on Garmin Connect (running, cycling, swimming, multi-sport / triathlon). Uses the unofficial API via Garmin session (email + password, including accounts with two-step verification); OAuth tokens are stored encrypted to reduce sign-ins.

name: Bling
description: Bling ERP (SMB and e-commerce management, by Locaweb) via the official v3 API, sales orders, products, contacts (customers/suppliers), payables/receivables, NF-e invoices, stock and registrations, over OAuth 2.0. Read-only. Pairs with the Banco MCP to reconcile finances with the bank statement. You create a free app in the Bling developer portal, paste the credentials and click Authorize.

name: PNCP
description: Search Brazilian government tenders and public procurement (PNCP): find notices and auctions by keyword, state and modality, opportunities filtered by value range, full procurement detail with line items and prices, tender documents (PDF link and text), contracts, price-registration records and annual procurement plans. Platform-hosted, no credentials.

name: Codex Imagem
description: Generate images with your own ChatGPT subscription (Plus, Pro or Team), without spending API credits. Connect your Codex login once and ask for the image in plain language, the file is saved to your mcp.ai account.

name: WHOOP
description: Your WHOOP data in the assistant, read-only: recovery, sleep, strain, workouts, cycles and body measurements via the official v2 API (OAuth 2.0). The platform provides the OAuth app, just click Authorize and log into your WHOOP account, no password shared with the assistant. Wearable data is not a substitute for medical advice.

name: Google Tasks
description: Google Tasks in natural language: create, list, edit and complete tasks and task lists. The platform provides the OAuth app, just click Connect and pick your Google account. Multiple Google accounts can be connected to the same MCP.

name: Mercado Financeiro BR
description: Brazilian financial market data (B3): quotes, fundamentals, dividends, REITs (FIIs), BDRs, crypto, FX and macro indicators (Selic, inflation). Platform-hosted, no credentials, monthly subscription.

name: Anthropic Billing
description: Anthropic organization usage and cost reporting through an admin API key connected by the user.

name: GitHub
description: Connect your GitHub account and use 823 tools for developer tools straight from your AI agent. Connect in one click, no API key needed. GitHub is a code hosting platform for version control and collaboration, offering Git-based repository management, issue tracking, and continuous integration features.

name: INPI
description: Look up trademarks and patents at Brazil's INPI: trademark search by name (prior-art/conflict check), process detail by number, and trademarks/patents by holder (CPF/CNPJ). Platform-hosted, no credentials, pay per query with prepaid credit.

name: Mercado Livre Vendedor
description: Mercado Livre (Latin America's largest marketplace) via the official API, seller profile and reputation, listings, orders, questions, shipping (Mercado Envios), categories and visits, over OAuth 2.0. Read-only. You create the app in the Mercado Livre DevCenter and authorize via OAuth.

name: Hotmart
description: Hotmart digital-products platform via the official API: sales (history, summary, participants, commissions, refund), subscriptions (list, cancel, reactivate, change billing day), coupons, products/offers/plans, events and members area (modules, lessons, students, progress). Generate your credentials (Client ID + Client Secret) under Tools → API Credentials in the Hotmart dashboard.

name: Investigação Cadastral
description: Cadastral investigation of people and companies: location, corporate ties/relationships, participations, ultimate beneficial owner, estimated income, death and vehicle ownership. Platform-hosted, prepaid per query.

name: Transparência (CGU)
description: Brazilian Federal Transparency Portal: sanctions (CEIS, CNEP, CEPIM) and Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) by CPF/CNPJ for due diligence and compliance, plus expenses received by recipient (how much a company received from the federal government, by agency and month, with the empenho/liquidation/payment documents). Covers the federal Executive branch. Platform-hosted; no user credentials.

name: Crédito & Score
description: Credit score and analysis for people and companies: score, dossier, defaults, positive reports, Central Bank SCR and protests. Platform-hosted, prepaid per query.

name: OneDrive
description: OneDrive in natural language: search, read, create, move and share files and folders. The platform provides the OAuth app, just click Connect and pick your Microsoft account. Multiple accounts can be connected to the same MCP.

name: AdvBox
description: Wrapper for the official AdvBox API (legal practice management): cases (with history, movements, publications), clients/contacts, tasks/notes and finance (transactions). Read + create and update for cases and transactions. Authenticated by the firm's API token.

name: Projuris ADV
description: Wrapper for the official Projuris ADV REST API (legal practice management): cases, people (clients/parties), tasks (deadlines/appointments), updates, timesheet, files (GED), fee contracts, subjects, court notices, service records, finance (income/expenses) and users. Read, search and create/update over REST. Authenticates with the client_id/secret provided by support when the API is contracted (Premium plans) plus your Projuris ADV username and password. Generic tools cover all 757 API resources.

name: iFood Vendas
description: Sales, orders and finance for your iFood store right in your AI assistant's chat. List orders by period, see payouts and financial entries, menu and store availability, all read from the Partner Portal. You connect with your own store's email and password.

name: Kiwify
description: Kiwify digital-products platform, sales (list, detail), subscriptions (list, cancel), products and affiliates via the official API. Generate your credentials (Client ID + Client Secret) and copy your Account ID under Apps → API in the Kiwify dashboard.

name: TCU Jurisprudência
description: Public search of the Brazilian Federal Court of Accounts (TCU) case law: keyword search across rulings (acórdãos), selected jurisprudence (enunciados) and binding summaries (súmulas), with summary, highlighted snippets, rapporteur and links to full text. Also lists the latest rulings. Platform-hosted, no credentials.

name: Tabela FIPE
description: Reference vehicle prices in Brazil (FIPE table), cars, motorcycles and trucks. Browse by brand/model/year, check the current-month price or any month since ~2001, see the depreciation curve (history) and search by model name. Own index (refreshed monthly), fast API; no credentials, platform-hosted.

name: Cakto
description: Cakto payment gateway and checkout for course/infoproduct sellers, read orders, sales analytics, subscriptions, churn and customers, plus build the catalog through the official API: create and edit products, offers and checkout order bumps. Generate your credentials (Client ID + Client Secret) under API in the Cakto dashboard, ticking the read scopes and, to create or edit, the write ones too.

name: DataCrazy
description: DataCrazy omnichannel CRM (WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook) via the official API: leads, deals, pipelines and stages, activities, tags, products, conversations and service, lists, attachments and notes. Generate your API key in the dashboard under Settings → API Keys.

name: WebDiet
description: Patient, meal plan, prescription, chart and anthropometry management for dietitians.

name: Figma
description: Connect your Figma account and use 49 tools for images and design straight from your AI agent. Connect in one click, no API key needed. A collaborative interface design tool.

name: Google Search Console
description: Connect your Google Search Console account and use 6 tools for analytics straight from your AI agent. Connect in one click, no API key needed. Google Search Console provides tools to monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot your site's presence in Google Search results.

name: Supabase
description: Your Supabase account in natural language: run SQL, apply migrations, manage tables, storage, edge functions and branches, and search the docs. Connect your account in one click, no key or token.

name: Google Keep
description: Google Keep MCP, read and edit your notes, lists, labels and collaborators. Connect with your Google email + master token (there is no official API; we use the private Android-app API via a master token, like gkeepapi). Supports multiple Google accounts. Stateless server running on Cloudflare Workers; credentials live only in the platform WCA. By default it only manages notes tagged with the 'keep-mcp' label (pass unsafe=true to act on any note).

name: Querido Diário (municipal)
description: Searches MUNICIPAL official gazettes from thousands of city halls (Querido Diário / Open Knowledge Brasil) by term or name, procurements, appointments, contracts. Complements DJEN (judicial) at the municipal level. Free, no credentials.

name: Telegram
description: Connect your Telegram account and use 18 tools for team chat straight from your AI agent. Connect with your own API key. Telegram is a cloud-based messaging app with a focus on security and speed. Build bots to send messages, manage chats, and interact with users.

name: Kommo
description: Kommo CRM (formerly amoCRM), the conversation-first sales CRM (WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram) used by SMBs and agencies. Read and write leads, contacts, companies, tasks, notes, pipelines, tags, custom fields, users, events, conversations and catalogs through the official v4 API. You provide your account subdomain and a Long-Lived Token and the platform operates on your account. Includes a raw call tool for any API endpoint.

name: Notion
description: Notion in natural language: create, search and edit pages, notes, tasks, wiki, docs and databases, organizing your projects. The platform provides the OAuth app, just click Connect and authorize your Notion workspace. Multiple workspaces can be connected to the same MCP.

name: Wise
description: Wise (https://wise.com) MCP, multi-currency account access via Personal Token + SCA key. Reads profiles, balances, transfers, activities and, crucially, full per-currency statements including CARD_TRANSACTION events (Wise debit-card purchases), which the Brazilian Open Finance connector (Pluggy) does not sync. Stateless server running on Cloudflare Workers; credentials live only in the platform WCA.

name: Biblioteca de Anúncios
description: Discover who is advertising on Instagram and Facebook about a topic, and read each ad's copy, call to action and landing page. Public data from Meta's ad library, hosted by the platform, no credentials required.

name: Conta Simples
description: Business finance on Conta Simples, bank and card statements, corporate cards (list/block/unblock), categories, users, roles and invites. Generate your credentials at https://ib.contasimples.com/integracoes/api/credenciais

name: Magnific
description: Magnific in natural language: upscale images, generate and list your creations. Connect your Magnific account and use your plan credits.

name: ZapSign
description: ZapSign electronic document signing via the official API: create documents for signature (from PDF, DOCX, URL or template), track status, manage signers and authentication, templates, webhooks, background checks and account plan. Generate your API Token in the dashboard under Settings → Integrations → ZAPSIGN API.

name: Autos Processuais
description: Case file documents by CNJ number using the lawyer's own court credential: lists the initial petition, defense, rulings and filings as seen in the court system and downloads them as PDF and text, ready for AI analysis. Covers e-SAJ, eproc, PJe and Projudi with the lawyer's login and password (or A1 certificate). Asynchronous, charged per case.

name: Google Analytics
description: Connect your Google Analytics account and use 4 tools for analytics straight from your AI agent. Connect in one click, no API key needed. Google Analytics tracks and reports website traffic, user behavior, and conversion data, enabling marketers to optimize online performance and customer journeys.

name: Feegow Clinic
description: Full clinic management on Feegow Clinic, patients, appointments, providers, specialties, insurance, finance, electronic medical records, proposals and benefits card. Authenticated via access token (x-access-token) generated in Settings → API.

name: Webmotors
description: Vehicle search on Webmotors, Brazil's largest automotive marketplace. Search listings by make/model, get full details (specs, photos, seller) and the model's average market price — the real asking price on the marketplace, not just the FIPE table.

name: Federal Revenue (Company)
description: Looks up a company's registration data at the Federal Revenue from the CNPJ, optionally with the ownership structure. Platform-hosted, no credentials, pay per query with prepaid credit.

name: Google Ads
description: Connect your Google Ads account and use 22 tools for ads and conversion straight from your AI agent. Connect in one click, no API key needed. Google Ads, is an online advertising platform developed by Google, where advertisers bid to display brief advertisements, service offerings, product listings, and videos to web users.

name: MFIT Personal
description: Client, workout, body composition, retention and finance management for personal trainers.

name: Airbnb (não oficial)
description: Search Airbnb stays straight from your AI agent. Give the city, the dates and how many guests, and get listings with total price for the period, discount, rating, reviews, location and photo, plus each listing's full description and photos. Filters by price range and property type. Hosted by the platform, no login and no credentials. Read-only public data: it does not book or message hosts. Not an official Airbnb service.

name: DietBox
description: Patient, prescription, anthropometry, scheduling, chat and food diary management for dietitians.

name: F360 Finanças
description: Financial and accounting reconciliation on F360 Finanças (management for retail chains and franchises), card reconciliation, accounting/managerial reports, transfers between accounts, charts of accounts, customers/suppliers and invoices, via the official Public API. Read-only. Pairs with the Banco MCP to reconcile bank statements with card reconciliation. Auth via the API key generated in the F360 account under Webservices.

name: Grok
description: Connect your Grok account and use 8 tools for artificial intelligence straight from your AI agent. Connect with your own API key. Grok is xAI's API platform for text, image, video, embedding, file, search, and voice capabilities.

name: MCP Remoto
description: Connect any remote MCP server to your AI. Provide the URL, auth headers and transport, and the remote server's tools become available in your toolkit.

name: Organizze
description: Your Organizze finances in natural language: consolidated balances, monthly overview, transaction search, credit card invoices, recurring bills, budgets, reports by category and tag, cash flow forecast and Open Finance status. Connect your account in one click, no key or token. On the Organizze screen, uncheck "Permitir alterações" if you want read-only access.

name: Buscador Google
description: Search Google straight from your AI agent. Web results, images, videos, news, products, scholarly articles and patents, plus local business lookup with phone, address and rating, and full text extraction from any page. Accepts up to 100 queries in a single call. Hosted by the platform, no credentials, you pay per query.

name: Reclame Aqui
description: Manage your company's complaints on Reclame Aqui through the Company Area account. You provide the company user and password and the platform logs into your account to list complaints, read details, check reputation and reply to consumers. It does not use the paid RA API, it uses the same area you already access on the site.

name: State Court Cases (TJ)
description: Looks up cases in the state Court of Justice by CPF, CNPJ, party name, case number, instance, and state. Platform-hosted, no credentials, pay per query with prepaid credit.

name: Veículo
description: Look up a vehicle by license plate against official sources (make/model, year, status, restrictions). Platform-hosted, no credentials, pay per query with prepaid credit.

name: Criminal Record (State Police)
description: Looks up a person's criminal record certificate at the state police (Polícia Civil), from the CPF, RG, state, and name. Built for the holder to check their own record. Platform-hosted, no credentials, pay per query with prepaid credit.

name: Auditor Fiscal
description: Check whether a Brazilian invoice was issued with the right taxes. Send the NF-e line items and get back every divergence between what the invoice declares and what the tax rules require, with the field, the expected value and the arithmetic. Covers ICMS, tax substitution, DIFAL, PIS, COFINS and the new IBS and CBS, plus Simples Nacional effective rate and Fator R. Platform-hosted, no credentials.

name: CRM
description: Your own CRM, fully customizable and agent-driven. Start with contacts, companies and a sales pipeline, then create your own objects and fields and get an API instantly. You own all the data, isolated in a database of your own. Pay only for what you store and use.

name: Lawsuits (Full)
description: Full lookup of a person's or company's lawsuits from the CPF or CNPJ, with per-case detail. Platform-hosted, no credentials, pay per query with prepaid credit.

name: Federal Tax Clearance (CND)
description: Issues the federal tax clearance certificate (CND) for a person or company from the CPF or CNPJ. Platform-hosted, no credentials, pay per query with prepaid credit.

name: ElevenLabs
description: ElevenLabs in natural language: generate speech in any language, create and manage voices, compose music, dubbing, pronunciation dictionaries, history and account usage. You connect with your own ElevenLabs API key, and credits come out of your own subscription.

name: Base de Conhecimento
description: Your private knowledge base: upload documents (.md, .txt, .docx, PDF, images), the platform indexes everything semantically and the agent retrieves the relevant context on demand. Built for firms. Each base is isolated, content stays encrypted on the platform. You pay only for what you store.

name: LegalOne
description: Wrapper for the official LegalOne API (Thomson Reuters / Novajus, Premium package): lawsuits and litigations, contacts, appointments and tasks, updates, documents, practice areas, service types and custom fields. Read, create and update, with OData style filters. OAuth2 (client_credentials) auth provisioned by Thomson Reuters per firm. Each collection depends on the scope your firm contracted with TR, and generic tools cover any endpoint outside the list.

name: Microvix
description: Microvix retail ERP (Linx, part of the Stone group) for store chains and franchises, via the official output WebService. Read-only: products, stock and inventory, customers and suppliers, sales movement and billing, orders, salespeople and the group's stores. No pagination, filter by date window and by store (CNPJ). Auth via the portal credentials (user, password, key and IdPortal) provided by Linx.

name: GestãoClick
description: GestãoClick ERP (business management for SMBs) via the official API: customers, suppliers, products and services, quotes, sales, service orders, purchases, invoices (product, consumer, service) and finance (payments, receivables, bank accounts, chart of accounts, cost centers). Generate the key pair in the dashboard under My apps, API.

name: iLovePDF
description: Connect your iLovePDF account and use 9 tools for documents straight from your AI agent. Connect with your own API key. iLovePDF provides APIs for processing, converting, optimizing, and signing PDF and image files.

name: Pagar.me
description: Stone's payments gateway (api.pagar.me), orders, charges (card, Pix, boleto), customers and cards, plans and subscriptions, recipients (split/marketplace), transfers, payables and invoices, via the official V5 API. Works across all versions: an sk_… key uses the V5 API (read + write); legacy accounts (ak_… key) get read access to the V1–V4 API (transactions, subscriptions, payables, balance). Auth via secret key generated in the dashboard → Settings → Keys.

name: RD Station
description: RD Station Marketing, contacts/leads (get, upsert, funnel), conversion events and webhooks via the official API (OAuth 2.0). You create the app in your own RD Station account and authorize over OAuth. (v1: Marketing; CRM coming soon.)

name: Microsoft Teams
description: Microsoft Teams in natural language: read chats and channel messages, post messages and replies, manage teams, channels and members, create meetings. The platform provides the OAuth app, just click Connect and pick your Microsoft account. Multiple accounts can be connected to the same MCP.

name: OpenAI
description: Connect your OpenAI account and use 126 tools for artificial intelligence straight from your AI agent. Connect with your own API key. Toolkit for OpenAI APIs: manage Assistants, Threads/Messages; upload/list/delete Files; list/retrieve Models (including vision/multimodal); and view fine-tune listings and events.

name: PagSeguro
description: PagSeguro / PagBank payments, orders, charges (get, cancel, refund), checkouts and public key via the official API. Paste the token generated under Online Sales → Integrations → Generate Token in the PagSeguro dashboard. A receivables companion to the Banco MCP (Open Finance).

name: Situação Cadastral
description: Check the registration status of a Brazilian CPF against official sources (name, status, birthdate, enrollment, deceased flag). Platform-hosted, no credentials, pay per query with prepaid credit.

name: Slack
